banner.title: Twubaha ubuzima bwawe bwite
banner.text: Dukoresha cookies n'ikoranabuhanga risa na zo. Cookies z'ingenzi zituma urubuga rukora. Ubyemeye, dukoresha kandi cookies z'ubushake ku bikorwa byihariye, isesengura n'iyamamazabikorwa. Ushobora kwemera zose, kwanga zose, cyangwa guhitamo ukurikije icyiciro, ukanahindura icyemezo cyawe igihe icyo ari cyo cyose.

preferences.title: Amahitamo ya cookies
preferences.text: Hitamo ibyiciro by'ubushake wemera. Cookies z'ingenzi ntizishobora kuzimywa kuko urubuga rudakora zitari zo.

necessary.title: Iz'ingenzi
necessary.description: Zikenewe ku mirimo y'ibanze nko gutanga umutekano, kugabanya umutwaro no kwibuka iri hitamo ry'uruhushya.

functional.title: Iz'imikorere
functional.description: Zibuka amahitamo nk'ururimi cyangwa akarere kandi zigashoboza ibikorwa byashyizwemo.

analytics.title: Isesengura
analytics.description: Zidufasha kumva uko urubuga rukoreshwa kugira ngo turunoze.

marketing.title: Iyamamazabikorwa
marketing.description: Zikoreshwa mu gupima no kugena amatangazo ajyanye n'umuntu ku mbuga zitandukanye.

blockedContent: Ibi bikubiyemo birafunze kugeza wemeye icyiciro cya "{category}".
